pr_title: Implement the main flow for the Exporting Engine
pr_body:
##### Summary
Closes #6956

##### Component Name
exporting engine (former name "backends")
pr_comments: The exporting engine should be merged into the master branch as an experimental feature.
Should we add the file `exporting.conf` as a valid option for the script `edit-config`?

I notice that we are not giving any warning for our users when two exporters are exactly the same and I think this could help our users. To detect this I used the following steps:

1 - I set inside netdata.conf:
```
enabled = yes
type = json
destination = localhost:5448
```
2 - And I used this `exporting.conf`:
```
[exporting:global]
    enabled = yes

[json:testing_1]
    enabled = yes
    destination = localhost:5448

[json:testing_2]
    enabled = yes
    destination = localhost:5449
```

My servers for this specific test were two `nc` so I received a lot of messages like this:

```
netdata ERROR : BACKENDS : BACKEND: failed to write data to database backend 'localhost:5448'. Willing to write 211333 bytes, wrote 155292 bytes. Will re-connect. (errno 35, Resource temporarily unavailable)
```

Normal servers  will accept more than one connection, this means that the final result would be data duplication. Another possibility is instead to say for our users that there are two equal connections and move in front with them, we should disable one of the duplication and move in front with only one, I think this is the best option between the two that I am bringing here.

> Should we add the file exporting.conf as a valid option for the script edit-config?

Yes, but not yet. The format hasn't been finalized yet and we haven't decided on transition from `netdata.conf` to `exporting.conf` so I prefer to have just a brief readme for now.

Manage this branch in Squash

Test this branch here: https://exporting-engine-1255n.squash.io
